journey.title: Morning: plan today and start the first focus block
journey.purpose: The core daily loop — inspect a realistic day, choose a manageable set of work, review a proposed plan, apply it deliberately, and start focused work — proving the honest planning loop is usable end-to-end.

steps.intent: See available capacity, the next useful action, and any commitment notices for today.
Add or select a manageable set of work and open the Day/Capacity perspective.
steps.via: Open Plan from the rail or a 'plan my day' affordance.

steps.intent: Generate a proposal and inspect original vs proposed placements, conflicts, and affected commitments.
Apply the reviewed changes explicitly and return to a truthful Today.
steps.via: Apply the proposal (a separate, revalidated command).

steps.intent: Start the first focus block on the chosen next action.
steps.via: Start focus from the next-action surface.
